headline: [Exclusive] Funding for USD 200 billion in US investment; government says some will be sourced through overseas borrowing
summary: The Korean government says part of the $200 billion funding for US investment will be sourced through overseas borrowing. Annual scale is put at $0.5 billion to $1 billion, using secured loans and syndicated bank loans.
why: Large outbound investment commitments tied to trade arrangements affect South Korea's external borrowing, currency exposure and corporate funding.
